type.text:
Type & materials

Display: Young Serif — 70s sci-fi paperback voice
Interface: Figtree 400–700
Code: JetBrains Mono (ligatures off)

Windows: 1.5px ink border, 12px radius, hard 5px offset shadow, pinstriped title bar. Icons are enamel-pin objects, not line icons. Paper grain sits over the whole desktop.

interactions.text:
Try it (press Play)

Double-click desktop objects or use the tray · drag title bars, resize from the corner, double-click a title bar to maximize
Universe: drag to drift, scroll to zoom, click a planet
Academy: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter runs code · finish Master to watch Origins grow
Missions: fix the four labels, run the checks
Sprout: click to pet; naps after 40s idle
Tweaks: Open on · Journey stage

limits.text:
Prototype limits

Python runs in a small JS interpreter that covers Origins-level syntax only (values, operators, f-strings, print/type/int/str/len, string methods). No blocks, loops or defs — it says so politely when you try.

For the real build: swap it for Pyodide in a Web Worker and keep the same console + Sprout error explanations.
